integrity: The predator-free linearization, renewal characteristic equation, parameter derivatives, and sharp-limit factorization are derived directly from the printed model. Classical renewal stability theory is treated as prior work rather than novel. The bundled checker provides only supplementary numerical replay of the analytic identities.
scientific_limitations: The threshold is a local linear predator-invasion criterion, not a global basin classification.

Monotonicity in juvenile predation and predator reproduction is exact for finite smooth maturation; the explicit maturation-age factorization is for the exact sharp-maturation limit with the source's numerical profiles.
The result does not classify coexistence-equilibrium or coexistence-cycle stability after invasion.
The source's separately proposed saturated-birth modification requires a fresh invasion calculation.
title: Exact non-reentrant predator-invasion frontier in an age-structured role-reversal model
